prompt: Filter a list of Event records with a Predicate chosen by the caller. Complete the keep method in EventFilter; the tests pass in lambda predicates that combine both record fields.
explanation: Taking a Predicate<Event> parameter inverts the usual control flow: keep supplies the looping, while the CALLER supplies the decision as a lambda. Inside the method the predicate is just an object with a test method returning a boolean. Because lambdas like e -> e.kind().equals("scroll") && e.size() < 10 can read every record component, one generic keep method replaces a whole family of special-purpose filter methods.
hints: Create a new empty ArrayList for the results -- never add to or remove from the input list.
Loop over the events and call p.test(e) to ask the caller's lambda whether to keep each one.
Add the event to the result list only when test returns true, then return the result list.
